title: Data and code for: Tracing closure obligations and payments in public data-centre records
notes: Code in this deposit is licensed under the MIT License (see LICENSE); data, registers and documentation under CC BY 4.0 (see LICENSE-DATA.md).
description: Derived data, source registers and code for a study of how far closure obligations, costs, financial assurance, payments and environmental evidence for data centres can be traced in public records: 18 identified Irish EPA licences, the EPA list of 197 registrations with financial provision requirements at 31 December 2025, the filed statements of eight licence-holding companies, and 27 international tracking records. The two record sets are reported separately and are not pooled. Agency and company documents are not redistributed; a source register gives publisher, date, URL where recorded, pages used and SHA-256.
